Now Cowork reads his emails, manages his calendar, writes in his voice, connects to his entire Notion workspace, and with scheduled tasks works while he sleeps
'CoWork OS' onboards you, sets everything up and improves over time; 'gets you ahead of 99% of users'
Setup is 'only really a morning's work', no code, no tech background; 'a full working assistant with you by lunch'
Product page (on screen): templated system with folder structure, onboarding coach, instruction templates, skills and specialist plugins; priced $129.00 USD
how_to_steps: Install the Claude desktop app and open the Cowork tab
Connect Gmail, calendar and Notion as connectors
Load the creator's CoWork OS templates (folder structure, instruction files, onboarding coach) and let Claude write SKILL.md files for your context
Use scheduled tasks so Cowork runs routines while you are away
Iterate: the system is pitched as improving over time as it learns your voice and workflows

relevance.why: Haji already runs Claude Cowork with Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Notion-style connectors, custom skills and scheduled routines; this is a beginner-onboarding product. The only takeaway is confirmation that packaged 'Cowork OS' templates sell at ~$129, which is a business-with-AI data point.

implement_score.why: Nothing to implement; Haji's existing skills (haji-email, morning, session-handoff, routines) already exceed what is pitched. Not worth $129. Possible indirect idea: productize a Cowork setup for veterans or small-business owners the same way.

verify: Does bettercreating.com actually sell 'Claude CoWork OS' at $129 and what is inside (templates vs. real skills/plugins)?
Does Cowork's scheduled tasks feature exist as described (the liked set mentions cloud scheduled tasks moving to mobile)?
Is the 'writes in my voice' claim backed by a specific voice-profile skill or just prompt instructions?

gap.what: Duplicate of liked content: Cowork assistant setups (Jarvis recipes, AIOS dashboard, board-of-advisors in Cowork, scheduled tasks news) are already covered. Only new element is a paid $129 'CoWork OS' template product as a sellable-info-product example.
